correctness.rationale: Binary 0/1 increment parametrization proves the zero-root characterization and total 2^(n-2). Restriction to the image gives an exact disjoint, finite integer recurrence. Nondecreasing defect yields necessary depth bounds; explicit anchor interpolation proves sufficiency. Extreme-rank and depth-two counts and rational bivariate series follow by direct binomial counting. A standalone checker independently verifies actual powers through n=16 and all recurrence constraints through n=32; numerical tests support, not replace, the universal proof.
